stories.title: Kawhi Leonard: a hero’s complicated return to the Toronto Raptors
summary: The Los Angeles native had hoped to end up in southern California, but instead the Raptors risked it all by swapping franchise cornerstone DeMar DeRozan for one year of an injured, malcontent Leonard.
It worked: Leonard led the Raptors to their maiden championship on the back of a historic playoff run, averaging 30.5 points, 9.1 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 1.7 steals en route.
Leonard won his second finals MVP to go alongside the one he had claimed with the Spurs when he helped them to the title in 2014.
